bullets.text: Nvidia's 2QFY27 beat (US$96.2bn revenue, +106% YoY vs US$91bn guided; FY28 growth guided ~70%) read as a volume opportunity for Indian SIs: CLSA ranks Infosys strongest on Nvidia-ecosystem capability, then TechM and TCS, with Persistent the only advanced tech partner in coverage. Cautious near term on AI deflation; AI net positive for SIs medium-to-long term.
bullets.source: CLSA — India IT: Nvidia 2Q27 read across

bullets.text: BofA adds four Japan AI-hardware ideas: initiates Dexerials at Buy (PO JPY4,700, 54% upside) on photodiodes for data-center optical transceivers, Nichicon at Buy and Nippon Chemi-Con at Neutral on AI-server aluminium capacitor demand, and upgrades Kao to Buy partly on its ~60% share in package-substrate cleaning agents.
bullets.source: BofA — APAC Signal-to-Noise: Four new AI ideas from Japan

bullets.text: BofA small-business payments data: alternative hiring indicator +21% YoY in July, profits at their highest level this year (transportation and manufacturing strongest) — US small-business activity rebounding, not rolling over.

US consumer K-shape persists: new vehicle sales above the 2025 average but carried by higher-income households — almost 20% of lower/middle-income households pay over $1,000/month in auto payments; restaurant recovery led by younger, lower-income consumers trading grocery for dining out.

AI capex cycle maturing per BofA: runway left in infrastructure investment, but capital is getting selective — investors now demanding project economics and monetization evidence rather than funding buildout on faith.

Kotak maintains BUY on HDFC Bank, FV Rs1,050 (CMP Rs720), after MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan said he will retire on 26 Oct 2026; the board has accelerated succession. Kotak flags the NIM gap vs peers still wide three years post-merger and expects the valuation discount to persist until leadership clarity emerges.
bullets.source: Kotak — HDFC Bank: Preparing for the next leadership chapter

bullets.text: PhillipCapital on Ather Community Day: new Konarc line on the EL platform starts at Rs99,999 (S 125 and S 161 ship Sep-26; S 100 in Q1 CY27); management explicit ASP will not drop — the platform cuts raw-material cost ~10–12%, battery warranty extends to 10 yr/100,000 km. Aurangabad capacity scales only from Q1FY28, so volume upside is an FY28 story.
bullets.source: PhillipCapital — Ather Energy Community Day 2026: Comprehensive Takeaways

bullets.text: Kotak first take: Ather launched the Konarc at its fourth Community Day in Bengaluru — the company's first entry into the mass EV scooter segment.
bullets.source: Kotak — Ather Energy enters mass EV scooter segment with Konarc

ai_semis.text: Nvidia 2QFY27: US$96.2bn revenue (+106% YoY) vs US$91bn guided; 3QFY27 guided to US$108bn ±2% and FY28 to ~70% growth, supply-constrained — citing an agentic-AI demand inflection, a US$2tn cloud backlog, and frontier AI labs at ~25% of FY28 revenue. Hyperscaler growth expected to reaccelerate from 4QFY27 as Vera Rubin ramps.
ai_semis.source: CLSA — India IT: Nvidia 2Q27 read across

ai_semis.text: The print lifted the whole complex into the 27-Aug close — NVDA +8.7%, AVGO +4.5%, TSMC ADR +2.3%, SOX +2.3% — while AMD fell 0.9%, framed as the beat being 'bad news for AMD and Intel'.

AI-hardware trade broadening down the supply chain: BofA initiates Japanese component names on optical-transceiver photodiodes and AI-server aluminium capacitors — AI deployments raising both volumes and content per server.
ai_semis.source: BofA — APAC Signal-to-Noise: Four new AI ideas from Japan
